name: Universal Popularity Crown: Neon Cat-ear Headphones
description: A pair of futuristic cat-ear headphones with a bold, adorable design, glowing with a signature pink neon light. The perfect proof that you've made it as a top streamer.
story: "Since you've decided to become the Astral Express's official game streamer, then... hehe, put these headphones on! Mm-hmm! Not bad, not bad. You're really starting to look the part! Pink totally suits you too, just like I said it would."

source.description: Available at the Gift of Stardust store
